candidates.claim: Switch sw-it-01 port GigabitEthernet1/0/11 is an active access port in VLAN 10 (not shutdown), although sw-it-01 is a CORP switch whose ports must stay in VLAN 30 and only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Return sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/11 to access VLAN 30 (or shut it down) and confirm that no OT device is intended to be connected to the corporate switch.
